review.body:
<!-- rivetari-judge-review round=1 -->
### Rivetari judge · round 1 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: unverified — The script builds with NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND=local, runs with -p 8080:8080, polls until ready, checks / and /cloud/login/ for 200 text/html plus page markers, and exits 1 with a message on failure. No e2e run proof is attached to show the real image passes.
- A2: met — cleanup() runs in finally and on SIGINT/SIGTERM. container is set before docker run, so a created-but-not-started container is removed too. docker info failure gives a clear daemon message, and a missing CLI is reported. Confirmed by reading the code only, not by an e2e run.
- A3: met — Plain .mjs using node:child_process and global fetch only, no dependency changes, with unit tests in src/lib/dockerSmoke.test.ts. The lint, typecheck and test results come from the deterministic checks and are not shown here.
- A4: met — Dockerfile and nginx.conf are unchanged, and the port stays 8080. The only image-related change is a minimal .dockerignore addition (.worktrees, .rivetari, coverage). The PR description should explain it.

<details><summary>3 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- The /cloud/login/ HTML check only matches a title that other /cloud/ pages probably share `scripts/docker-smoke-lib.mjs:15` — Add a login-specific marker that appears in the exported cloud/login/index.html (for example the login form's id or an RSC payload string unique to the page) to route.html.
- The daemon check trusts only the exit code of docker info --format `scripts/docker-smoke.mjs:87` — Treat an empty info.stdout.trim() the same as a non-zero exit code.
- The readiness response body is never read or cancelled `scripts/docker-smoke-lib.mjs:79` — In main, call `(await waitUntilReady(...)).body?.cancel()`, or cancel the body inside waitUntilReady and return only the status.

</details>

_claude-opus-5-5 · 1 call(s) · Claude reviews, humans merge._

suggestions.title: The /cloud/login/ HTML check only matches a title that other /cloud/ pages probably share
suggestions.detail: The only HTML marker for /cloud/login/ is "<title>BreathCloud", which the /cloud/ layout probably sets for every console page. The sign-in heading is only looked for in the JS chunks the page references. If nginx served a different /cloud/ page for the trailing-slash route, the HTML check could still pass and only the chunk scan would catch it. A1 asks for the HTML to contain the page's expected content.
suggestions.repro: Not reproducible from this diff alone. It would happen if nginx's try_files fell back to another /cloud/*/index.html whose chunks happened to include the sign-in copy.
suggestions.fix: Add a login-specific marker that appears in the exported cloud/login/index.html (for example the login form's id or an RSC payload string unique to the page) to route.html.

suggestions.title: The daemon check trusts only the exit code of docker info --format
suggestions.detail: Some docker CLI versions print the server error to stderr but leave the formatted ServerVersion empty. The script would then log "Docker ; building ..." and fail later at docker build with a less clear message.
suggestions.repro: Run `docker info --format {{.ServerVersion}}` with the daemon stopped on a CLI version that exits 0 for server errors.
suggestions.fix: Treat an empty info.stdout.trim() the same as a non-zero exit code.

suggestions.title: The readiness response body is never read or cancelled
suggestions.detail: waitUntilReady returns the Response and main() ignores it. The body stays unconsumed, which can hold an undici connection open until it is garbage-collected.
suggestions.repro: Any successful run: the first GET / response body is never read.
suggestions.fix: In main, call `(await waitUntilReady(...)).body?.cancel()`, or cancel the body inside waitUntilReady and return only the status.

acceptance.note: The script builds with NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND=local, runs with -p 8080:8080, polls until ready, checks / and /cloud/login/ for 200 text/html plus page markers, and exits 1 with a message on failure. No e2e run proof is attached to show the real image passes.

cleanup() runs in finally and on SIGINT/SIGTERM. container is set before docker run, so a created-but-not-started container is removed too. docker info failure gives a clear daemon message, and a missing CLI is reported. Confirmed by reading the code only, not by an e2e run.

Plain .mjs using node:child_process and global fetch only, no dependency changes, with unit tests in src/lib/dockerSmoke.test.ts. The lint, typecheck and test results come from the deterministic checks and are not shown here.

Dockerfile and nginx.conf are unchanged, and the port stays 8080. The only image-related change is a minimal .dockerignore addition (.worktrees, .rivetari, coverage). The PR description should explain it.
